chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Abdullah ibn Bahr, from Hariz, from Zurara, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'O Zurara! What do you say regarding a man who leaves his two parents and his brothers from his mother?' I said, 'A sixth for his mother, and whatever remains is for the father.'
He (peace be upon him) said: 'From where did you say this?' I said, 'I heard Allah, Mighty and Majestic, saying in His Book: "If he has brothers, then his mother shall have the sixth."'
He (peace be upon him) said: 'Woe to you, O Zurara! Those are the brothers from the father. So if the brothers were from the mother, they would not bar the mother from the third.'

key_terms.إِخْوَتَهُ مِنْ أُمِّهِ: his brothers from his mother (maternal half-siblings)

ai.seo_question: Do maternal siblings reduce the mother's inheritance share to one-sixth according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the critical Shia jurisprudential distinction between full siblings (from the father) and maternal siblings in determining the mother's inheritance share. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Quranic restriction to one-sixth applies only when full siblings are present, whereas maternal siblings do not bar the mother from her full one-third share, a nuance often debated in Usuli jurisprudence. This ruling underscores the precision required in interpreting the term 'ikhwan' (brothers) within the context of inheritance laws.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Abdullah Bin Bahr, from Hareyz, from Zurara who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Zurara! What are you saying regarding a man who leaves his two parents, and his brothers of his mother?’ I said, ‘A sixth for his mother and whatever remains, so it is for the father’.
So heasws said: ‘From where did you say this?’ I said, ‘I heard Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Saying in Hisazwj Book [4:11] but if he has brothers, then his mother shall have the sixth’.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Zurara! Those are the brothers of the father. So if there were brothers of the father, they would not be barring the mother from the third’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn SaTd from ‘Abd Allah ibn Bahr from Hariz from Zurarah who has narrated the following:

“Abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me, ’O Zurarah, what do you say about the case of a man who leaves behind his both parents and brothers from his mother’s side?’ He (the narrator) has said that he said, ‘One-sixth is for the mother and the rest is for the father.’

He (the Imam) asked, ’On what basis do you say so?’ I replied, ‘I have heard Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, saying in His book, ’. . . if there are brothers then one-sixth is for his mother.’ [4:11]
He (the Imam) said, ’Fie on you O Zurarah, they are brothers from the father’s side. If brothers are from the mother’s side, they do not bar the mother from receiving the one-third.’”
